headlines.text: On this day in 2022, a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Sammy Guevara vs. Cody Rhodes battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.55 ? a war that left everything in the ring ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. In what turned out to be Cody's final match in AEW before his shock WWE return, the two traded ladder-assisted suplexes, cutters, and Cross Rhodes across a wild 22-minute war, with Guevara finally winning by cracking Cody with the title belt itself.
It was 2024 when Komander vs. El Hijo del Vikingo vs. Kip Sabian vs. The Butcher met in a Number One Contender, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 4.87.

It was 2022 when Orange Cassidy vs. Adam Cole fought it out in a Lights Out match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a strong outing, part of the special Beach Break '21 - Night 1 card.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Jurassic Express vs. Private Party closed out Rampage, rated 6.76 in a back-and-forth tag team affair, part of the special Beach Break '21 - Night 2 card.
